items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: John Robichaux's band at the Old Lyric Theatre. ... It was, so far I can remember it was John Robichaux was the violin and the leader.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, was that with the Robichaux band?
John Robichaux's band at the Old Lyric Theatre.
You remember who else was in that band at that time?
